[SWS_CM_10255] Variant length field data type
⌈
If ApSomeipTransformationProps.sizeOfUnionLengthField is present for a
Variant specified the data type of the length field for the Variant shall be determined by
the value of ApSomeipTransformationProps.sizeOfUnionLengthField:
• std::uint8 if sizeOfUnionLengthField equals 1
• std::uint16 if sizeOfUnionLengthField equals 2
• std::uint32 if sizeOfUnionLengthField equals 4
If ApSomeipTransformationProps.sizeOfUnionLengthField is not configured
explicitly, the default value for SIZE_OF_UNION_LENGTH_FIELD as defined in [PRS_
SOMEIP_00121] shall be used.
